title: account_offers
key_points: The account_offers method returns a list of accounts that are eligible to receive offers.
It takes no parameters and always returns an array of offer account IDs.
This method is useful for determining which accounts can receive new offers.
The returned account IDs are always in lexicographic order.
limitations: Only works with accounts that have the capability to receive offers.
Does not include accounts that are ineligible for receiving offers due to various reasons.
asserts: The account_offers method provides a list of accounts eligible to receive new offers, ordered lexicographically.
